description: This file defines a user interface component for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It implements a tab-based navigation UI with status indicators, handling different UI states and navigation between tabs like Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings. It includes composable functions to render the tabs, status bar, and associated screens, with internal state management and interaction logic.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: An enum representing the main navigation tabs with labels and icons.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: An enum representing different status indicators for connection states.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main Composable function that manages the tab navigation UI, including status bar and bottom tab bar, and switches between different content screens based on the active tab.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Displays the screen tab content, including canvas view, refreshing when connected.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Displays a top status bar with connection status indicator.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Displays the bottom tab bar for navigation between different sections.
